prompt:
Coverage gate passes when a source file is never loaded by any test

scripts/check-coverage.ts enforces a per-file and overall line-coverage floor over src/, but it only looks at files that appear in coverage/lcov.info. Bun only writes lcov records for files some test actually imports, so a new module with no tests at all (say src/tools/new-thing.ts) is simply missing from the report and the gate passes. Untested files are exactly what the gate should catch.

Expected: every non-test source file under src/ (*.ts and *.tsx, excluding *.test.ts(x) and *.d.ts) that the lcov report never mentions should fail the gate with a message naming the file. A few files legitimately have no test that loads them and need an explicit, explained exemption: src/index.ts (entry shim, exercised by the compiled-binary e2e tests) and the type-only modules src/agent/events.ts and src/ui/runtime.ts.

Requirements: `evaluate` in scripts/check-coverage.ts gains two parameters, `evaluate(lcovText, threshold, files: string[], exempt: Record<string, string>)`, where `files` are repo-relative paths like "src/a.ts" and `exempt` maps path to reason. Each path in `files` absent from the report and not in `exempt` adds exactly one entry to `failures` that contains the path and the text "not loaded by any test". The overall percentage is still computed from the lcov records. Also export `EXEMPT: Record<string, string>` whose keys are exactly src/index.ts, src/agent/events.ts and src/ui/runtime.ts, each with a reason longer than 5 characters.

Add or update tests as appropriate.
